[[File:NullificationResin-KOTOR-29.png|250px|thumb|right|The nullification resin coating Sith artifacts]]
'''Nullification resin''' was a wrapping used by the [[Jedi Covenant]] on [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] to dampen their random malevolence. With resin surrounding the devices, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could not feel the evil emanating from them. The resin was placed on countless artifacts in the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]] on [[Odryn]], including [[Ludo Kressh's pedicure set]] and [[Exar Kun's lightsaber/Legends|Exar Kun's lightsaber]]. Up to three grades of the resin were known.
